features.quote: Set a hard turn cap (e.g., 30) and a token budget.
features.justification_quote: turns-to-cutoff dominates cost since spirals are long

features.quote: Don't over-tune to max trigger rate. Pick tasks where p(spiral) lands around 0.3–0.7 for the current model.
features.justification_quote: Near-0 and near-1 rates have terrible power for detecting regressions — you want to be on the steep part of the curve.

features.quote: optimizing for it will give you an eval that doesn't do what you want... you'll learn almost nothing generalizable
features.justification_quote: when a number moves between model versions, you won't know if the model changed or if your tasks happen to hit a different sensitivity
